title: DANGEROUS MORNING PRAYER BEFORE YOU START YOUR DAY
text: Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. We worship you, Lord. We worship you, Father. We bow our hearts before you tonight. You are the King of Kings and the Lord of Lords. There is none beside you. There is none above you. You reign supreme over heaven and over earth. And we have come tonight to give you the highest praise. Hallelujah. Before we go any further, I want you to do something for me. I want you to lift your two hands right where you are and just worship God for 60 seconds. Not a casual worship, not a distracted worship. I want you to worship him like he deserves to be worshiped. Open your mouth and magnify the name of the Lord. Tell him he is worthy. Tell him he is faithful. Tell him he is the almighty. Go ahead, worship. Yes, Lord. Yes, Lord. We magnify you. We praise you. Shondo karabasile. We give you all the glory. We give you all the honor. Receive our worship. Father, receive it as a sweet smelling sacrifice before your throne tonight. Hallelujah. Thank you, Lord. Thank you, Father. Thank you, Holy Ghost. Sit down. You can be seated. Praise the Lord. I need your attention tonight. Can I have your full attention? Because what the spirit of God is about to release in this atmosphere tonight is not ordinary. I want you to understand something. You did not come here by accident. You did not stumble upon this broadcast by mistake. The hand of the Lord orchestrated your presence in this moment. There is a word that God has prepared specifically for you. And before this night is over, your life will never remain the same. Can I hear your amen? Now, before we go into the depths of what the spirit wants to do tonight, I want to encourage you to share this message with someone. Share it on your WhatsApp status. Send the link to three people. Share it on social media. You do not know who God wants to reach tonight through your obedience. You might be the instrument that God uses to change somebody's life forever. Someone is waiting for this exact word and the Holy Spirit might use you to deliver it. Do not keep this to yourself. When God gives you bread, it is not just for you. Learn to distribute the blessing. Hallelujah. Now listen carefully. I want to teach you something before we enter into prayer tonight. And I need you to follow me with your spirit, not just your mind. Are you ready? Are you truly ready? Because some of the things the Lord is about to show us will require faith. And faith does not operate in the realm of the casual. You must be intentional tonight. Open your Bibles to the book of Isaiah 43. I want you to see verses 18-9. The word of the Lord says, "Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing. Now it shall spring forth. Shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert." Did you hear what the Lord just said? He said, "Behold, I will do a new thing." Now, catch this. The word behold in that context is not a passive word. It is an instruction. God is saying, "Pay attention. Look here. Direct your gaze to what I'm about to do." The reason many believers miss their season of breakthrough is not because God did not move. It is because they were not paying attention when he moved. And the Lord says something very profound. He says, "Now it shall spring forth." The word now tells you something about timing. There is a chyros moment attached to what God is about to do. And that moment is now. Not tomorrow, not next month, not when you feel ready. Now, tonight in this very service, something is springing forth in your life. And the Lord is asking you, "Shall ye not know it?" You see, the tragedy of many people is not that God has not been working. The tragedy is that they could not perceive what God was doing. Your perception determines your participation. If you cannot see it, you cannot seize it. And I am praying for you tonight that the eyes of your understanding will be enlightened. That the scales will fall off. That the spiritual cataracts that have covered your vision will be removed by fire. Because when you begin to see what God is doing, everything changes. Now look at the second scripture. Go to the book of Joel 2:es 25- 26. And I will restore to you the years that the locust had eaten, the canker worm and the caterpillar and the palmer worm, my great army which I sent among you. And ye shall eat in plenty and be satisfied. And praise the name of the Lord your God that had dealt wondrously with you, and my people shall never be ashamed. Somebody shout hallelujah right there. This is one of the most powerful restoration promises in all of scripture. God is not just saying he will give you something new. He's saying he will compensate you for everything the enemy stole, every wasted year, every broken relationship, every financial loss, every health crisis, every delayed promise, God says, "I will restore." And the word restore there in Hebrew carries the idea of complete repayment with interest. God does not just give back what was taken. He multiplies it. But here is what I want you to see. The title of tonight's ministration is open your mouth and release this dangerous prayer right now. And there is a reason the Lord put that title in my spirit. Listen very carefully. There are dimensions of breakthrough that are locked behind the words of your mouth. The Bible says in Proverbs 18:21, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof." Your mouth is not just an organ for eating food. Your mouth is a spiritual weapon. Your mouth is a gateway to the supernatural. When you open your mouth in agreement with what God has said, you activate forces that the natural mind cannot comprehend. Let me show you something from scripture. In Mark 11 23- 24, Jesus said, "For verily I say unto you, that whosoever shall say unto this mountain, be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea, and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he said shall come to pass, he shall have whatsoever he saith. Therefore, I say unto you, what things soever ye desire when you pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them. Jesus did not say, "Whosoever shall think about this mountain." He did not say, "Whosoever shall wish about this mountain." He said, "Whosoever shall say," there is a speaking dimension to breakthrough. Some of you have been thinking your way through problems. You have been wishing your way through situations. But tonight, God is calling you to speak. Open your mouth, release the word, declare the decree because there is creative power in your tongue when it is aligned with the word of God. And this is why the prayer we're about to release tonight is dangerous. Not dangerous in the sense that it will harm you. No, it is dangerous to every satanic agenda. It is dangerous to every demonic assignment. It is dangerous to every curse that has been operating in your bloodline. It is dangerous to every altar that has been speaking against your destiny. When you open your mouth and release this prayer, something will shift in the realm of the spirit. Thrones will be shaken, chains will be broken, gates will be opened, and the enemy will flee from your life in seven different directions. I speak to someone under the sound of my voice right now. The Lord is telling me to tell you that your season of silence is over. You have been quiet for too long. You have been passive for too long. You have been enduring what you should have been destroying. But tonight, something is changing. The spirit of the Lord is awakening the warrior inside of you. You are not a victim. You are a victor. You are not a casualty. You are a conqueror. And when you open your mouth tonight, every enemy of your destiny will hear the voice of the God who sent you. Hallelujah. Now, before we enter into prayer, let me lay a few more foundations because I want your faith to be at the right level. Turn with me to the book of Ezekiel chapter 37. You know this passage, the valley of dry bones. But I want you to see something you may have missed before, verses 1-4. The hand of the Lord was upon me and carried me out in the spirit of the Lord and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones, and caused me to pass by them roundabout. And behold, there were very many in the open valley, and lo, they were very dry. And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones leave? And I answered, Oh Lord God, thou knowest. Again he said unto me, prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, Oh ye dry bones, hear the word of the Lord. Look at the instruction God gave to Ezekiel. He did not say, pray over these bones. He did not say fast over these bones. He said, "Prophesy. Speak to them." And when Ezekiel spoke, something happened. The bones began to come together. Senus appeared. Flesh covered them. Skin wrapped around them. And when he spoke again to the wind, breath entered them, and they stood up as an exceedingly great army. Somebody, I'm talking to you tonight. There are areas of your life that look like a valley of dry bones. Maybe it is your marriage. Maybe it is your finances. Maybe it is your health. Maybe it is your career. Maybe it is your ministry. Things have been dead for so long that you have almost accepted it as normal. But God is saying to you tonight, prophesy. Speak to those bones. Speak to that dead situation. Speak to that barren womb. Speak to that empty bank account. Speak to that stagnant career. Because when you speak in alignment with my word, resurrection power will flow. Now, let me give you another one. In 2 Kings 4:es 1-7, we see the story of the widow of one of the sons of the prophets. Her husband had died and left her in debt. The creditor was coming to take her two sons as slaves. She had nothing in her house except a small jar of oil. And the prophet Elisha told her, "Go borrow vessels from all your neighbors, empty vessels. Borrow not a few. And when thou art come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shall pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full. And the oil kept flowing until every vessel was full. When the vessels ran out, the oil stopped. The supply was only limited by the vessels. And Elisha said, "Go sell the oil and pay thy debt, and leave thou and thy children of the rest." Why am I showing you this? Because I want you to understand that the miracle was activated when she obeyed the word. The oil was already there. It was a small jar. Nothing spectacular in the natural. But when she poured in obedience to the prophetic instruction, the supernatural multiplied what the natural could not. And tonight the prophetic instruction is this. Open your mouth. Your mouth is the vessel. The word of God is the oil. When you speak, the oil will flow. When you pray, the oil will multiply. When you decree, the oil will not stop until every area of lack in your life is filled. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. I am steered in my spirit right now. I can feel the weight of the Holy Ghost in this atmosphere. Something is about to happen. Something is about to shift. I need you to stand to your feet right now. Stand up. Stand up wherever you are. If you are watching from your home, stand up. If you are in your car, if you can safely do so, pull over and focus. This is not a regular prayer meeting. This is a divine encounter. The heavens are open over this place and the Lord is ready to move. Now, I want you to lift your right hand toward heaven. That hand represents your agreement with God. That hand represents your faith. That hand represents your surrender. And I want you to understand something. Every word you are about to release is not just a prayer. It is a legal decree in the courts of heaven. You are not begging. You are enforcing. You are not pleading. You are commanding because you have been given authority. Luke 10:1 19. Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy. And nothing shall by any means hurt you. Nothing. Nothing. Nothing shall by any means hurt you. Do you believe that? Then let your faith be active tonight. Let your mouth be open. Let your spirit be engaged. We are going into the place of prayer. Father, we come before your throne tonight in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. We do not come in our own strength. We do not come in our own righteousness. We come in the name that is above every name. The name at which every knee shall bow, the name at which every tongue shall confess. We come in the name of Jesus. And Father, we ask that you would ren the heavens and come down tonight. Let the mountain shake at your presence. Let every obstacle tremble. Let every barrier dissolve. We're not leaving this place the same way we came in. Something must change. Something must shift. Something must break in the name of Jesus. Now pray with me. Open your mouth and say these words with fire. I decree and I declare that tonight is my night of turnaround. I am not going back to where I came from. I am not returning to the same bondage. I am not repeating the same cycle. Tonight by the power of the Holy Ghost, I break free from every limitation that has held me captive. Every chain that has been around my destiny, I command you to break in the name of Jesus. Every cage that has been built around my purpose, I command you to shatter in the name of Jesus. Every wall that has been erected between me and my breakthrough, I command you to fall in the name of Jesus. Pray, pray, pray with everything in you. The spirit of God is moving. I can feel it. The atmosphere is charged. Keep praying. Father, I come against every altar that has been erected against my life. Every altar in my father's house that is speaking against my progress, I decree catch fire. Every altar in my mother's lineage that is programming failure and disappointment into my bloodline, I decree be consumed by the fire of the Holy Ghost. every village altar, every territorial altar, every ancestral altar, every marine altar, every witchcraft altar. I speak the blood of Jesus against you tonight. I overturn you by the power of the resurrection. You will not stand. You will not prevail. You will not succeed against my life, against my family, against my destiny, against my calling. I pull you down in the name of Jesus. Oh, the fire of God is falling. I can sense it. Something is being dismantled in the spirit realm right now. Keep praying. Do not stop. There is someone listening to me right now and you have been under a financial embargo for years. Doors open but they close before you can walk through them. Opportunities come but they evaporate like morning dew. Money comes into your hands but it disappears as though there is a hole in your pocket. I am talking to you. The Lord is showing me that there is an ancestral covenant that was made in your bloodline and it was sealed with blood. It has been the source of financial stagnation in your family for generations. But hear me tonight. By the blood of Jesus Christ, I break that covenant. I nullify that agreement. I declare it null and void. The blood of Jesus speaks better things than the blood of Abel. And tonight, the blood of Jesus is speaking over your finances. Release. Release. Release. Let the embargo be lifted. Let the gates of provision be opened. Let wealth begin to flow to you from the north, from the south, from the east, and from the west in the name of Jesus Christ. Somebody shout, "It is broken." Say it like you believe it. It is broken. Now listen, I am not done. We are going deeper. The spirit of God is taking us somewhere tonight and we must follow. I want to pray for marriages tonight. There are people listening to me whose marriages are under attack. The enemy has introduced discord. He has introduced suspicion. He has introduced emotional distance. He has introduced third parties. Some of you are on the verge of divorce and you do not even know how you got there. But I want you to hear me clearly what God has joined together. Let no man put us under. That is not just a verse for wedding ceremonies. That is a legal decree from the courts of heaven. And tonight I am enforcing that decree over your marriage. In the name of Jesus, I speak peace to every troubled marriage under the sound of my voice. I rebuke the spirit of divorce. I rebuke the spirit of adultery. I rebuke the spirit of emotional manipulation. I rebuke the spirit of pride that refuses to forgive. I rebuke the spirit of bitterness that holds on to past offenses. I command the fire of God to enter your home and consume every work of darkness. Let love be rekindled. Let trust be restored. Let communication flow. Let intimacy return. Let the hedge of protection that the enemy broke down be rebuilt by the angels of the most high. I decree that no weapon formed against your marriage shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against it in judgment, you are condemned in the name of Jesus. Pray for your marriage right now. If you are not yet married, pray for your future marriage. Cover it with the blood of Jesus. Seal it with fire. Protect it with the word of God. Pray. I speak to destiny. Oh, I need to address this. There are destinies that have been hijacked. The enemy knows that if your destiny is fulfilled, his kingdom in your territory will be destroyed. So he has worked over time to delay you, to confuse you, to distract you, to make you settle for less than what God designed for you. But hear me tonight. The book of Jeremiah 29:1 says, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, sayeth the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you an expected end." God has an expected end for you. There is a blueprint in heaven with your name on it. There is a scroll that was written before you were formed in your mother's womb. And the enemy cannot erase what God has written. I decree tonight that every hijacked destiny is restored. Every delayed purpose is accelerated. Every confused identity is clarified. You will know who you are. You will know why you are here. You will know where you are going. The fog is lifting tonight. The confusion is breaking tonight. The mist that has covered your understanding is being burned away by the fire of the Holy Ghost. I speak clarity. I speak direction. I speak alignment. I speak divine positioning. You will not miss your place. You will not miss your season. You will not miss your assignment in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. I feel the power of God right now. Keep praying. We're in a moment. Shaker Mondo Shaliba the spirit of the Lord is speaking. There is a man I am seeing you. You are in your 40s. You have been carrying a burden of failure. You feel like life has passed you by. Every plan you have made has crumbled. Every business you have started has failed. And you have begun to believe the lie that maybe God has forgotten you. Maybe this is your portion. Maybe you are just destined for mediocrity. Listen to me. That is a lie from the pit of hell. God has not forgotten you. Your name is written on the palms of his hands. And the Lord says to tell you tonight that the reason for the delay was not abandonment. It was preparation. He was building something inside of you that required time. But the building season is over. The launching season has begun. You are about to step into the greatest chapter of your life. Everything that failed before will succeed now. Everything that died before will leave now. Everything that closed before will open now. Receive it in the name of Jesus. Now I need to pray over health. Oh, this is strong in my spirit. There are people listening to me who are battling sickness. Some of you have received medical reports that shook you to your core. The doctor said something that made sleep flee from your eyes. cancer, fibroid, kidney disease, heart complications, diabetes, autoimmune conditions, strange illnesses that have no medical explanation. I want you to hear me tonight. The same Jesus who healed the woman with the issue of blood is alive tonight. The same Jesus who opened blind eyes is in this atmosphere right now. The same Jesus who cleansed the leper and raised the dead is reaching out his hand toward you at this very moment. 1 Peter 2:4 says, "Who his own self bear our sins in his own body on the tree that we being dead to sins should live onto righteousness by whose stripes you were healed." You were healed. That is past tense. It is a finished work. Your healing is not a future event. It is a present reality. And tonight I am calling it forth in the name of Jesus Christ. I speak to every sickness and every disease in the bodies of everyone under the sound of my voice. I command you to leave. Cancer dry up from the root. Fibroid dissolve by fire. Kidney failure I command supernatural regeneration in the name of Jesus. Heart disease I rebuke you. Be healed in Jesus name. diabetes, your hold is broken. The blood sugar will normalize. The organs will function properly. Every autoimmune condition, I command the immune system to recalibrate by the power of the Holy Ghost. I speak to blood. I speak to bones. I speak to tissue. I speak to organs. I speak to cells. I speak to DNA. I command divine healing to flood your body from the crown of your head to the soles of your feet. sickness. You are an illegal tenant. This body is the temple of the Holy Ghost and you have no legal right to occupy it. Get out. Get out. Get out in the name of Jesus. If you believe you are receiving your healing right now, put your hand on the part of your body that has been affected and begin to release faith. Say, "I receive my healing." Say it. I receive my healing. By the stripes of Jesus, I am healed. No weapon formed against my body shall prosper. I will live and not die. I will declare the works of the Lord in the land of the living. I am healed. I am whole. I am restored in Jesus name. Oh, glory to God. Thank you, Lord. Thank you, Holy Ghost. Now, listen. We are not done. We're going into the realm of deliverance. And this part is very important. I need your focus. There are covenants and curses that operate in bloodlines. I know some people do not like to hear this. They say, "We are in the new covenant." Yes, you are. But let me ask you a question. If the new covenant automatically cancelled every demonic operation, why did Paul say in Ephesians 6:12, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places." Why did he say we wrestle if the battle was already over? The battle is won in Christ, but you must enforce the victory. And enforcement requires knowledge, prayer, and authority. Some of you are dealing with patterns. Patterns of marital failure, patterns of poverty, patterns of premature death, patterns of mental illness, patterns of addiction, patterns of near success syndrome where you always get close but never quite break through and you cannot explain it naturally. You have the education, you have the skill, you have the connections, but something always goes wrong at the last minute. That is not bad luck. That is a spiritual operation and it must be addressed spiritually. Galatians 3:13 says, "Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a cause for us, for it is written, cause is everyone that hangeth on a tree. Christ has redeemed you. But redemption must be appropriated. You must take hold of what Christ has done. And the way you take hold is through knowledge, faith, and prayer. So tonight, I am going to lead you in a prayer of deliverance. And I want you to pray like your life depends on it. Because for some of you, it does. In the name of Jesus Christ, I place my life, my family, my destiny, my finances, my health, my marriage, my children, and my ministry under the covering of the blood of Jesus. I plead the blood over every department of my life, and I declare that no evil shall befall me, neither shall any plague come n my dwelling. Now pray after me with fire. Every covenant that was made on my behalf without my consent, I break you tonight by the blood of Jesus. Every covenant made at my naming ceremony that tied my destiny to a demonic entity, I break you. Every covenant made through sacrifices that were offered when I was a child, I break you. Every covenant sealed by the blood of animals. Every covenant sealed by the eating of certain foods. Every covenant sealed by the cutting of flesh. Every covenant sealed by the pouring of libations. I break them all tonight. I renounce every agreement. I renounce every allegiance. I declare that I am bought with a price. I belong to Jesus Christ and to him alone. No other entity has a claim on my life. No other altar has a voice over my destiny. The blood of Jesus has settled it. I am free. Every curse operating in my bloodline, I command you to break tonight. The cause of poverty, break. The cause of barness, break. The cause of untimely death, break. The cause of marital failure break. The cause of mental illness break. The cause of addiction break. The cause of stagnation break. The cause of shame and disgrace. Break. The cause of profitless hard work. Break. Every word that was spoken over my life by an angry parent, by a bitter relative, by a jealous friend, by a wicked neighbor. I cancel those words tonight. They shall not stand. They shall not come to pass. I overrule them by the blood of Jesus and by the power of the Holy Ghost. I come against every evil monitoring spirit that has been assigned to my life. every spiritual surveillance, every astral projection, every familiar spirit that has been tracking my movements, every demonic agent that has been sent to study my patterns and use the information against me. I decree, be blinded by fire, be confused by the blood of Jesus, lose your assignment. I release the angels of war to pursue and scatter every agent of darkness that has been monitoring me and my family. run, scatter, be destroyed in the name of Jesus. Oh, I feel the fire. I feel the fire of the Holy Ghost in this place. Pray, pray. Do not relent. We are in the threshing floor. The chaff is being separated from the wheat. The dross is being burned away. Keep praying. The spirit of God is speaking. There is a woman. I can see you. You have been praying for a child for years, many years. You have gone to doctors. You have done treatments. People have mocked you. Some have even suggested that maybe it is not God's will for you to have children. But tonight, I hear the Lord saying, "Sarah laughed, but I still gave her Isaac." Hannah wept, but I still open her womb. Elizabeth was barren, but I still gave her John. And you, my daughter, you will not be an exception. The God who opens wombs is touching you right now. I am not speaking from emotion. I am speaking from the spirit. By this time next year, you will carry your child. The reproach is over. The shame is over. The waiting is over. Receive your miracle in the name of Jesus. And there is another person. You have children, but your children are far from God. They have gone into the world. They are living recklessly. They are involved in things that break your heart. You pray for them and it seems like the prayers are bouncing off the ceiling. But hear the word of the Lord tonight. Isaiah 49 24-2 says, "Shall the prey be taken from the mighty or the lawful captive delivered." But thus said the Lord, even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered. For I will contend with him that contended with thee, and I will save thy children. Did you hear that? God said, "I will save thy children." Not might, not maybe. I will. Your children are coming back. Your sons are coming back. Your daughters are coming back. The prodigal is returning. The influence of the world is losing its grip. The prayer you have been praying day and night is not wasted. It has accumulated before the throne of God. And tonight, it reaches the tipping point. I decree that your children are saved. Your children are delivered. Your children are restored to purpose. Your children will serve God and fulfill their destiny in the name of Jesus. Now, let us pray about time and virtue. This is critical. Some of you have lost time. Years have gone by with nothing to show for them. You look at your age and you look at your accomplishments and there is a painful gap between where you are and where you should be. The enemy stole your time. He wasted your years through wrong relationships, through bad decisions, through illness, through depression, through confusion, through misdirection. But remember what Joel said, I will restore to you the years that the locust had eaten. God is a God of acceleration. What should take 10 years, he can compress into two. What should take 5 years, he can accomplish in 6 months. He's not bound by time because he created time. And tonight I am releasing a prayer of acceleration over your life. Father, in the name of Jesus, I ask for the restoration of time. Every year that was wasted, I ask for supernatural acceleration to recover them. Let the blessings of decades be compressed into months. Let the progress of years be achieved in weeks. Let divine speed be released. Let the fastforward button of heaven be pressed over the lives of everyone praying tonight. What would have taken them 30 years, let them achieve in three. What would have taken them 20 years, let them see in two. Catapult them, Lord. Accelerate them, fast track their destiny. Let them move from the back of the line to the front, from the bottom to the top, from obscurity to prominence, not by their might, not by their power, but by your spirit, says the Lord of hosts in Jesus' name. And virtue, I must address this. There are people whose virtue has been manipulated. What do I mean? Your spiritual currency, your gifts, your anointing, your favor, your grace. There are demonic operations that target the virtue of believers. They steal your glory. They redirect your star. In the name of Jesus, I declare every virtue that has been stolen from my life is restored tonight. Every gift that was taken from me in the dream, come back now. My star, you will shine. My gift, you will function. My anointing, you will increase. My favor you will manifest. I am not diminished. I am not depleted. I am not reduced. I am full. He connects you with the right person at the right time for the right purpose. And sometimes one connection can change your life forever. Esther was an orphan, but one connection to the king gave her access to the throne. I decree that your divine connections are being activated tonight. The people you need to meet, you will meet them. The doors that need to open, they will open. The introductions that need to happen, they will happen. I decree that this week, this month, this season, God is connecting you with destiny helpers. People who will sponsor your vision. People who will open doors for you. People who will speak on your behalf in rooms you cannot enter. People who will invest in your purpose. People who will pray for you when you are too weak to pray for yourself. I release divine connections in the name of Jesus. Every satanic disconnection, I rebuke you. Every good relationship the enemy has destroyed, I command restoration. Every bridge the enemy has burned, I decree supernatural rebuilding. You will not be isolated. You will not be alone. God is surrounding you with the right people for the right season. Hallelujah. Now listen, I am approaching something very strong in my spirit and I need your absolute attention. I want to address the subject of witchcraft and spiritual attacks. I know this sounds intense, but I am led by the Holy Spirit and I will not hold back. There are people here tonight who have been under serious spiritual attack. Not just random problems, systematic, coordinated, targeted attacks. You can feel it. Things that should work do not work. A darkness that locks, a constant sense of oppression that you cannot shake. Let me tell you what is happening. There are agents of darkness who have been assigned to frustrate your life. They meet at night. They discuss your progress. They strategize against your breakthrough. They use enchantments, divination, and all manner of dark arts to program evil into your experience. But hear me tonight. The Bible says in Numbers 23:23, "Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel. What God has blessed, no man can cause. Every meeting that was held against you in the darkness, I scatter it by fire.
